phonics.description: Letter sounds, word pronunciations, phonics drills

items.en: A says ah, like in apple
items.af: A sê ah, soos in appel

items.en: B says buh, like in ball
items.af: B sê buh, soos in bal

items.en: C says kuh, like in cat
items.af: C sê kuh, soos in kat

items.en: D says duh, like in dog
items.af: D sê duh, soos in hond

items.en: E says eh, like in egg
items.af: E sê eh, soos in eier

items.en: M says mmm, like in mama
items.af: M sê mmm, soos in mama

items.en: S says sss, like in sun
items.af: S sê sss, soos in son

items.en: T says tuh, like in tree
items.af: T sê tuh, soos in boom

narration.description: Hero moments - intro, story beats, key celebrations

items.en: Welcome to NovaLearning! I'm Thandi, and together we're going to explore the beautiful Rainbow Nation of South Africa!
items.af: Welkom by NovaLearning! Ek is Thandi, en saam gaan ons die pragtige Reënboognasie van Suid-Afrika verken!
items.zu: Siyakwamukela ku-NovaLearning! NginguThandi, futhi ndawonye sizovakashela iRainbow Nation yaseNingizimu Afrika!

items.en: Ubuntu means I am because we are. In our world, we learn together, we grow together, and we celebrate together!
items.af: Ubuntu beteken ek is omdat ons is. In ons wêreld leer ons saam, groei ons saam en vier ons saam!
items.zu: Ubuntu kusho ukuthi ngingumuntu ngabantu. Emhlabeni wethu, sifunda ndawonye, sikhula ndawonye, sigubha ndawonye!

items.en: You did it! You're a true Rainbow Nation champion! Your Ubuntu spirit shines bright!
items.af: Jy het dit reggekry! Jy is 'n ware Reënboognasie kampioen! Jou Ubuntu gees skyn helder!
items.zu: Ukwenzile! Uyiqhawe leRainbow Nation langempela! Umoya wakho we-Ubuntu ukhanya kakhulu!

items.en: Welcome to the Ubuntu Stokvel! Here we learn about sharing and saving together, just like our communities do.
items.af: Welkom by die Ubuntu Stokvel! Hier leer ons oor deel en spaar saam, net soos ons gemeenskappe doen.
items.zu: Siyakwamukela ku-Ubuntu Stokvel! Lapha sifunda ngokwabelana nokonga ndawonye, njengoba imiphakathi yethu yenza.

items.en: Welcome to the Spaza Shop! Let's learn about coins and trading at our very own community shop.
items.af: Welkom by die Spaza Winkel! Kom ons leer oor munte en handel by ons eie gemeenskapswinkel.
items.zu: Siyakwamukela esitolo se-Spaza! Masifunde ngezinhlamvu zemali nokuhweba esitolo sethu somphakathi.

items.en: Great job!
items.af: Goed gedoen!

items.en: Amazing! You're so clever!
items.af: Fantasties! Jy is so slim!

items.en: Almost there! Let's try again together.
items.af: Amper daar! Kom ons probeer weer saam.

items.en: Keep going, you can do it!
items.af: Hou aan, jy kan dit doen!

items.en: You're a star!
items.af: Jy is 'n ster!

items.en: I'm so proud of you!
items.af: Ek is so trots op jou!

items.en: You're making our rainbow shine brighter!
items.af: Jy laat ons reënboog helderder skyn!

items.en: That's the Ubuntu spirit!
items.af: Dit is die Ubuntu gees!

items.en: Together we can do anything!
items.af: Saam kan ons enigiets doen!

items.en: Hmm, not quite. Let's look at this together!
items.af: Hmm, nie heeltemal nie. Kom ons kyk saam hierna!
items.zu: Hmm, akukhona kahle. Masibheke lokhu ndawonye!

items.en: Drag the shape to the right place
items.af: Sleep die vorm na die regte plek

items.en: Tap the picture that matches
items.af: Tik op die prentjie wat pas

items.en: Listen carefully and choose the right answer
items.af: Luister aandagtig en kies die regte antwoord

items.en: Count the objects and tap the number
items.af: Tel die voorwerpe en tik op die nommer

items.en: Use your finger to trace the letter
items.af: Gebruik jou vinger om die letter na te trek

items.en: Match the coin to the right amount
items.af: Pas die muntstuk by die regte bedrag

items.en: Pick the colour that matches
items.af: Kies die kleur wat pas
